states.claim: file_line is allocated storage of size LSIZE; if allocation fails the function returns without further resource acquisition.
pat is allocated storage of size len+5, used to build the search pattern, then freed; on allocation failure control jumps to fpip_end.
regmatch.regprog is initialized to NULL and later set to a compiled regex program; on compilation failure control jumps to fpip_end.
incl_regmatch.regprog is initialized to NULL and later set to a compiled regex program; on compilation failure control jumps to fpip_end.
def_regmatch.regprog is initialized to NULL and later set to a compiled regex program; on compilation failure control jumps to fpip_end.
files is allocated as a zero-cleared array of max_path_depth SearchedFile entries; on allocation failure control jumps to fpip_end.
new_fname is set to a newly allocated file name from the include match; if already searched it is freed and cleared to NULL.
files[depth+1].fp is set to the result of mch_fopen on new_fname; if opening fails new_fname is freed, otherwise new_fname becomes files[depth].name and curr_fname.
When the file stack is full, bigger is allocated as a larger SearchedFile array; on success entries are copied, old files freed, and files is replaced by bigger.
When reading an included file reaches EOF, files[depth].fp is closed and depth is decremented, moving to the including file.
At function end, all still-open files are closed, their names freed, remaining names freed, and the files array freed.
At fpip_end, file_line is freed and all three regex programs are released.

executions.claim: In the already-searched loop, i starts at 0 and is incremented; if i equals depth+1 it is set to old_files; the loop breaks when i equals max_path_depth.
When i is 0, p is set to incl_regmatch.endp[0] and i to STRLEN(p); otherwise if p > line, p may be decremented and i incremented based on surrounding quote or angle bracket characters.
Before writing p[i] = NUL, save_char holds p[i]; after msg_outtrans_attr, p[i] is restored to save_char.

When depth+1 equals old_files, a bigger array of max_path_depth*2 SearchedFile is allocated; if allocation succeeds, entries are copied and old_files is increased by max_path_depth and max_path_depth is doubled.
If mch_fopen succeeds, depth is incremented; if the incremented depth equals old_files, files[old_files].name is freed and old_files is incremented.
When def_regmatch matches, p is set to def_regmatch.endp[0] and advanced while *p is non-NUL and not a word character.
When define_matched or compl_status_sol() is true, startp is skipwhite(p) and matched is set by comparing startp with ptr for len characters.
If matched and define_matched and whole and startp[len] is a word character, matched is set to FALSE.
When regmatch.regprog is non-NULL and vim_regexec succeeds, matched is set to TRUE and startp is set to regmatch.startp[0].
When skip_comments is true and define_matched is false, matched may be set to FALSE if the line is a comment leader or if a comment start appears before startp.
